Hi Renato, it's Dana. Thanks for today. That was a really useful session. Here are the three rules we wrote, so you don't forget them. Rule one: you must stay in position near the peak. Don't drift to the shoulder. Rule two: you mustn't waste waves. A small wave in the first minute is a mistake. Patience wins heats. Rule three: you don't have to catch ten waves. Two good waves are enough. Oh, and one more thing. You mustn't paddle behind a surfer with priority. That's interference, and the penalty is really big. Okay. Watch the replay again on Saturday, but only once. You don't have to watch it every night!

Hey mate, it's Kai. I've just read the rules for the semifinal on the website, and there are some new things. First, every surfer must wear a colored jersey, but you don't have to bring one. They give it to you on the beach. Second, you must check in at seven, at the tent near the parking lot. If you're late, you can't surf. And the heats are twenty-five minutes now, not twenty. One more thing: phones. You mustn't use your phone in the competitors' area. Leave it with Bev. That's it. See you at training tomorrow!
